verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at assemblyai.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and the docs also publish a /docs/llms.txt. Beyond that, AssemblyAI ships agent-oriented docs: an agent-instructions.md that agents can refetch via AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or .cursorrules one-liners, with token-saving query parameters (?lang, ?excludeSpec). It also documents a coding-agent-prompts page with curated SDK context and a Docs MCP server for mid-session doc lookups. The probe-verified llms.txt is the independent corroboration, and the 404 on docs.md is minor given the other agent-facing surfaces.
